items.title: LangChain earns ISO/IEC 42001 certification for LangSmith
problems: The item says LangChain had not previously described this certification. | The source does not establish whether LangChain had described the certification before this page.

The item says LangChain previously used LangSmith traces, evaluations, and agent permissions as governance evidence. | The source says these materials were audit evidence for the certification, but does not establish that they were described or used as governance evidence before that certification.
notes: The source explicitly dates the announcement November 24, 2026, matching the item date.
